name: Static webpage hosting infrastructure behind an MCP

mentions.name: Static webpage hosting infrastructure behind an MCP
mentions.description: Personal infrastructure platform for hosting static webpages with optional data storage, user accounts, notifications, and shared "rooms", all exposed behind an MCP and assembled from nearly-free ($0) AWS static services.
mentions.audience: Made for the author personally, with access that can be extended to friends and family.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Infrastructure for hosting static webpages with options for storing data, having users, sending notifications, shared "rooms", and various other bits and bobs all behind an mCP. All $0 practically because it's made up of static services from AWS.

Made for me, but I can provide access to friends and family, which is nice.
